values.description: Base URL of the Django development server. Change to your staging/prod URL when deploying.
Auth token for a school user. Auto-set by 'Login School' and 'Register School' requests.
Auth token for a teacher user. Auto-set by 'Login Teacher' and 'Register Teacher' requests.

Auth token for a superuser. Obtain via: python manage.py shell -c "from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token; from django.contrib.auth.models import User; t,_=Token.objects.get_or_create(user=User.objects.get(username='admin')); print(t.key)"
ID of a subject need. Auto-set by 'Create Subject Need'. Change manually if needed.
ID of a teaching subject. Auto-set by 'Add Teaching Subject'.
ID of a match record. Auto-set by 'Get School Matches' and 'Get Teacher Matches'.
